title: A stack in the CycleWire benchmark: apps/<id>/bench.json

name.description: How the stack is named in results.

kind.description: control: a baseline, not a product. The rest describe what the stack is.

summary.description: One or two sentences on how this stack builds the page.

build.description: Shell command that builds the app for production, run in its folder.

start.description: Shell command that starts the production server on $PORT, run in its folder.

search.description: live: results update as you type. submit: the search form must be sent.

packages.description: npm packages whose installed versions results record.

idioms.description: Every choice that departs from, or picks among, the defaults, with the documentation that recommends it.
